notes.title: A new game! From humble to heinous...
notes.content: [p]Hey friends![/p][p]It’s Jacob — the dev behind [i]Bass Monkey[/i] and [i]The Last Humble Bee[/i].[/p][p]I’ve been quietly working on a new game for the past 6 months, and it’s finally time to announce it:[/p][p][b]Raccoon Crime Spree[/b]![/p][p]Play as a raccoon that commits crimes — steal cars, boop pedestrians, and hide in garbage cans.[/p][p]It’s coming to Steam, and you can wishlist it here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3661980/"][/dynamiclink]If you enjoyed my past games, I think you’ll get a kick out of this one.[/p][p]—Jacob[/p]

notes.title: The Last Humble Bee is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
You can now play The Last Humble Bee!

It's a fast-paced, heart-BUZZING rogue-lite where you play as a bumble bee saving the bees from Hell!

Check it out!
Cheers,
Jacob

notes.title: Release Date Set: November 21st, 2024!
notes.content:
Hi all!

EXCITING NEWS! Mark your calendars -- The Last Humble Bee will be released on November 21st!

After more than 2 years of development, you can finally play as this swashbuckling bumble bee fighting his way to Hell!

I'm really happy with how the game turned out; there's a bit more content than what was available in the demo, and you can finally see what happens once you make it to Hell ;)

Excited to have you all play the full game!
Cheers,
Jacob

notes.title: Play the FREE DEMO and watch the Announcement Trailer!
notes.content:
Hi all!

I’m super thrilled to share… you can now play the FREE DEMO and watch the ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER!

Man, I’ve been working on this game for over a year now, so I’m thrilled that you can finally play the demo. I think the game is actually REALLY FUN so I’m proud of how it is turning out!

Please feel free to let me know what you think, either over in the steam forums, [url=jacob@bassmonkeygame.com]by email[/url], or [url=https://twitter.com/YakobSoup]DM me on twitter[/url].

Also, be sure to check out my Announcement Trailer! I made all the music myself:

[previewyoutube=UyjPgUYQpH0;full][/previewyoutube]

Fun fact, the soundtrack contains sampled sounds from REAL BUMBLEBEES! But don’t worry, no bees were harmed in the making of this game (or the soundtrack) lol.

As always, feel free to [url=https://twitter.com/YakobSoup]follow me on twitter [/url]to keep up with game updates, and [url=https://www.yakobsoup.com/humble-bee-email-list]join my email list[/url] for free stuff and news. I’m planning for a full game release in 2025 so I’m still hard at work on the game 😊
Best,
Jacob

notes.title: Follow these socials to stay up to date with The Last Humble Bee Development
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This post is for anyone who wants to follow the development of the game and see updates on its progress. Below are a handful of links to my socials.

My Email List: [url=https://www.yakobsoup.com/humble-bee-email-list]https://www.yakobsoup.com/humble-bee-email-list[/url]

You can join my email list for some cool exclusive stuff, like a free world map. This is your best bet for getting sneak-peaks and staying in-the-loop on my major updates.

Twitter/x: [url=https://twitter.com/YakobSoup]https://twitter.com/YakobSoup[/url]

Over on Twitter I'll be posting things like screenshots of new content, gifs, and videos showing new mechanics. I'll also be sharing articles about the game and other info like release dates.

My website: [url=https://www.yakobsoup.com/]https://www.yakobsoup.com/[/url]

Over on my website you can find a press kit, occasional game development blogs, and links to my other game(s).

YouTube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC7vhKc9iZhO0jUX8lxXb0hg]https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC7vhKc9iZhO0jUX8lxXb0hg[/url]

YouTube is where you'll find me the least. I plan on using YouTube to post more "Milestone' type content like trailers and other big announcements.

Steam: You're already here!

You can also follow the game on Steam! I'll be posting progress updates in blog/text form right here in the community hub occasionally. So by following the game you'll see those updates on your Steam news feed.

That's it! Thanks for reading :)
Cheers,
Jacob
